items.title: 4.7.2 Product ki zyada se zyada miqdar aur bache hue excess reagent ki miqdar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.7.2, printed pages 87-89, with Sample Problem 4.19 worked, our bar figure and Quick Check 4.9 answered.

blocks.text: Jo reactants (reaction ki stoichiometry ke hisab se) zyada miqdar mein hon aur reaction ke aakhir mein bina react kiye bach jayein, unhein “excess reagents” (ya excess reactants) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Excess reactant
blocks.text: Jo reactant reaction mukammal hone ke baad bina react kiye bach jaye, use non-limiting ya excess reactant kehte hain.
Hydrogen aur oxygen se pani banne ka reaction dekhein:

items: Agar 2 moles hydrogen (4 g) ko 2 moles oxygen (64 g) se react karayein to sirf 2 moles (36 g) pani banega, kyun ke equation ke mutabiq 2 moles (4 g) hydrogen sirf 1 mole (32 g) oxygen se react karti hai. Hydrogen oxygen ke muqable mein kam hai, is liye hydrogen limiting reactant hai aur 1 mole oxygen bach jati hai.
Agar 1 mole O₂ aur 1 mole H₂ milayein to sari H₂ react kar jayegi aur O₂ bach jayegi, kyun ke 1 mole H₂ ko sirf ½ mole O₂ chahiye. Baqi ½ mole O₂ excess hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.19 (Excess reactant)
blocks.problem: Natural gas zyada tar methane (CH₄) hai. Methane poori tarah jal kar CO₂ aur pani banati hai: CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g). a) 30 g CH₄ aur 50 g O₂ se kitne gram CO₂ banegi? b) Reaction ke baad excess reagent ke kitne gram bachenge?
steps: Qadam 2: Dono reactants ke moles: CH₄ = 30 g ÷ 16 g mol⁻¹ = 1.875 mol; O₂ = 50 g ÷ 32 g mol⁻¹ = 1.563 mol
Qadam 3: Har reactant se CO₂: 1 mol CH₄ se 1 mol CO₂, to 1.875 mol CH₄ se 1.875 mol CO₂
2 mol O₂ se 1 mol CO₂, to 1.563 mol O₂ se 0.5 × 1.563 = 0.7815 mol CO₂
O₂ kam CO₂ deti hai, is liye O₂ limiting reactant hai
Qadam 4: CO₂ ka mass = 0.7815 mol × 44 g mol⁻¹ = 34.39 g (jawab a)
Qadam 5: Istemal hui CH₄: 2 mol O₂, 1 mol CH₄ se react karti hai, to 1.563 mol O₂ ne 1/2 × 1.563 = 0.7815 mol CH₄ istemal ki
Qadam 6: Bachi hui CH₄ = li gayi – istemal hui = 1.875 – 0.7815 = 1.0935 mol
blocks.answer: Bachi hui CH₄ ka mass = 1.0935 × 16.0 = 17.5 g (jawab b)

blocks.alt: Do jore patti-graph (bars). Oopar 'Maujood moles': CH4 1.875 mol (lambi neeli patti), O2 1.563 mol (surkh patti). Neeche 'Har ek se kitna CO2 ban sakta hai': CH4 se 1.875 mol, O2 se sirf 0.7815 mol (chhoti surkh patti). Surkh khaane mein 'Limiting reactant: O2'. Neeche nateeje: CO2 bani 0.7815 x 44 = 34.39 g; CH4 bachi 1.0935 x 16 = 17.5 g (excess).
blocks.caption: Sample Problem 4.19: limiting reactant O2, 34.39 g CO2 aur 17.5 g CH4 baqi (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Tees gram methane 1.875 mol hai aur pachas gram oxygen 1.563 mol. Methane 1.875 mol CO2 bana sakti hai magar oxygen sirf 0.7815 mol, to oxygen mehdood karti hai aur 34.39 g CO2 zyada se zyada ban sakta hai. Oxygen 0.7815 mol methane istemal karti hai, 1.0935 mol, 17.5 g, ghair-react shuda chhor kar. Hydrogen misal mein 2 mol H2 2 mol O2 ke saath sirf 36 g pani dete hain aur 1 mol oxygen chhorte hain. Percentage yield asal product ka is nazriyati zyada se zyada se muqabla karti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wali patti (bar) batati hai ke kitne moles maujood hain; neeche wali batati hai ke har reactant se kitna CO₂ ban sakta hai. O₂ ki patti chhoti hai, yani O₂ limiting hai; CH₄ ki lambi patti ka farq bachi hui (excess) methane hai.

blocks.prompt: Neeche diye reaction ke mutabiq kaun sa mixture sab se zyada product (NH₃) dega?
blocks.explanation: Har mixture mein limiting reactant dekhein. (a) bilkul sahi ratio: 2 mol NH₃. (b) H₂ limiting: 3 mol H₂ se 2 mol NH₃. (c) N₂ limiting: 1 mol N₂ se 2 mol NH₃. (d) H₂ limiting: 2 mol NH₃. Sab 2 mol NH₃ dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Mazeed mashq: 34.0 g ammonia, 80.0 g oxygen se 4NH₃ + 5O₂ → 4NO + 6H₂O ke mutabiq react karti hai. Limiting reactant, NO ka zyada se zyada mass aur bacha hua excess reactant nikalein (H = 1.0, N = 14.0, O = 16.0).
blocks.explanation: NH₃ = 34.0 ÷ 17.0 = 2.0 mol; O₂ = 80.0 ÷ 32.0 = 2.5 mol. NH₃ se NO = 2.0 mol (4 : 4); O₂ se NO = 2.5 x 4/5 = 2.0 mol. Dono barabar NO dete hain, yani mixture bilkul sahi ratio mein hai: koi excess nahi bachta, aur NO = 2.0 mol x 30.0 g/mol = 60.0 g.

items: Excess reactant: jo reaction ke baad bina react kiye bach jaye.
Product ka zyada se zyada mass limiting reactant se nikalta hai; bacha hua excess = liya gaya – istemal hua.
30 g CH₄ + 50 g O₂: O₂ limiting, 34.39 g CO₂ banti hai, 17.5 g CH₄ bachti hai.
